Lake Michigan at Sheboygan. Loving being back - have really missed this place.

Wisconsinite here — Sheboygan does have a neat surfing element to it as a very unique Great Lakes spot with consistent, solid waves when the weather allows. That’s where the nickname comes from. Also a v cool area w good food, art, culture, etc. Shoutout to their meat/bratwurst too!
The Great Lakes have a notable number of Sheboygan/Cheboygans.

Sheboygan is pretty nice. It's on the shore of Lake Michigan. It's got a nice mix of German and Hmong immigrants. Only in America can you get a city like that. It's also got a cool name. Sheboygan Sheboygan Sheboygan. Saying "Sheboygan sucks" is like saying "America sucks".

Sheboygan and all of the communities there are wonderful. Such a feeling of place and a lovely mix of small-town Americana and big-city culture. All along the Lake Michigan shore from Chicago to Green Bay, you still have a sense of the industrial Midwest. Friendly, broad-minded, wonderful.
